summary: Build integrated VoC and VoE listening systems with survey, text analytics, governance, and action planning. Enquire about training today.
lede: Voice of Customer and Voice of Employee systems combine feedback from surveys, service channels, and employees to guide improvements. This course is for customer experience, insights, and service professionals who need to connect feedback with accountable operational action. You will map listening points, classify comments and recurring issues, and create dashboards and closed-loop workflows to prioritize and track improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect customer, citizen, employee, service, and operational evidence. It suits beginner to intermediate practitioners who need a structured listening system rather than a vendor-specific software demonstration. A customer and citizen listening system is especially relevant when you need to link feedback signals with accountable improvement work.
audience: Contact Centre Managers using call reasons, transcripts
prerequisites: Working experience in customer experience, service operations, market research, employee experience, public service delivery, marketing insights, or data analysis is recommended. You should be comfortable reading spreadsheets and discussing service processes. No coding or programming is required. The course teaches AI-assisted text analytics and speech analytics at conceptual and operational application level, not technical engineering or production model deployment.
